name: watt
description: Shows how long each tool call took and a summary of each turn, a chip for each running subagent, and live plan progress bars above the prompt (the plan_progress tool, ported from plan-progress), with soft sounds when work ends, fails or waits for you.

keepSeconds.title: Finished agents stay (seconds)
keepSeconds.description: How long a finished subagent's chip stays in the agent row, until its × is pressed

twinkle.title: Twinkle the pixel fill
twinkle.description: Animate the dots of the summary fill. Off, they are drawn still

sounds.title: Play a sound when work ends
sounds.description: A soft sound when a main turn of 30s or more ends, when all running subagents finish, and when a progress bar finishes or fails, the error one when it failed; the decision one when Claude stops to ask you or a bar waits for you

showModel.title: Show the model on each chip
showModel.description: The model each subagent runs on, dimmed beside its time; dropped first when a chip is narrow

autoclose.title: Close finished progress bars on their own
autoclose.description: A finished bar leaves the progress bars above the prompt after the seconds below. Off, it stays until closed; a failed bar or one waiting on you always stays

doneBarSeconds.title: Finished bar stays (seconds)
doneBarSeconds.description: Seconds a finished progress bar stays above the prompt while closing finished bars on their own is on
